description.value: The Duke Saloon is Victoria's premiere country music venue, established in 2014 inside a heritage brick building originally constructed in 1902 to house BC Electric Company streetcars. Every night it opens, a live band performs on The Jim Beam Stage, making it a lively stop for cyclists looking to catch some authentic country music after a day on the road. The venue is 19+ and is a proud member of the BarWatch Program.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 12m; stands (2 spaces) at 41m; stands (2 spaces) at 51m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms The Duke Saloon at 502 Discovery Street, Victoria BC V8T 1G8, phone 250.388.3000. Active events listed for May and June 2026 confirm the venue is currently open. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site; all such fields default to null per absence-of-evidence rule.

Venue is 19+ only, which may limit access for some touring cyclists.
Open primarily Thursday–Saturday evenings; daytime access is very limited (office hours Wednesday–Thursday 10AM–2PM by appointment only).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bar and live music venue in downtown Victoria with confirmed events in May–June 2026. A legitimate stop for touring cyclists seeking evening entertainment.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Duke Saloon is a 19+ nightlife venue focused on country music. It is not a food-service establishment in the traditional sense — the website emphasizes beer, bourbon, and live bands rather than meals. Cyclist utility is primarily as an evening entertainment destination.
